subject: Temporary invoice-only onboarding request — StrataSeed pilot
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@strataseed.bio>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Finance Ops <acctspayments@strataseed.bio>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for StrataSeed trial

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro — we're excited to kick off the 90-day pilot with Redwood. A couple of procurement constraints on our side: our central purchasing team is implementing a new PO system and won't be able to issue POs for trials that start this month.

Is there any way Redwood can put StrataSeed on a temporary invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for the pilot? Estimated spend is modest: roughly $2–4k/week, probably up to ~$9k total for the 90 days. We can provide a signed SOW and a finance contact; we'd like Net30 terms if possible.

Attached: StrataSeed_SOW_Q3.pdf (SOW + expected usage)

If this helps, we can also provide a card on file or escrow arrangement if that reduces risk on your end. Let me know what you need from procurement to move forward.

Best,
Tom
Head of Ops, StrataSeed Labs
Tom Alvarez
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@strataseed.bio>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for StrataSeed trial

Tom — thanks for the SOW and context. We can consider a short, conditional invoice-only path for a pilot but Procurement needs a few controls in place before I can approve: 

- Signed SOW referencing trial dates and spend cap (we received the SOW but need a signed copy).
- W-9 (or equivalent tax form) and vendor contact for invoicing.
- Proof of insurance (commercial general liability) if applicable.
- Billing contact and PO fallback owner — we require a named person who will own the transition to a PO if the pilot converts.

Operationally, our proposed guardrails: one-time temporary invoice-only admission, capped at $9,500 total, Net30 payment terms, and a review at day-30 to confirm usage/controls. If you can provide the signed SOW and W-9 by EOD Tue we'll begin onboarding.

I'm looping in Marissa (on ops) and Karthik (sales/finance coordination) to confirm the exception path and the HubSpot/deal tag we'll use.

Attachment: redd_onboarding_checklist.pdf (what we need to collect)

—Irene
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-21T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: approval ask — StrataSeed temporary invoice-only (cap $9.5k)

Marissa / Karthik — quick internal note following Tom's ask. Summary: StrataSeed wants no-PO pilot for 90 days, estimated ~$9k. I suggested the temporary invoice-only route with the following required controls: signed SOW, W-9, monthly cap of $9,500, Net30, 30-day checkpoint. They offered card-on-file as an option.

Risk thoughts: low-dollar but medium sensitivity — vendor is a small biotech, no red flags from contract review but we don't have long-term history. Propose we: 
- Approve temporary onboarding up to $9,500, conditional on receiving signed SOW + W-9 and an assigned internal PO-owner at StrataSeed.
- Require HubSpot flag "pilot-invoice-only" and add a renewal task at day-60 for procurement to follow up.
- Ask Sales to collect card-on-file if AP is unable to comply within 10 days (fallback).

Marissa: would ops accept the invoice-only entry with these controls? Karthik: can Sales commit to the HubSpot tagging and the DocuSign envelope tracking?

Thanks,
Irene

Date: 2026-09-22T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for StrataSeed trial — APPROVED (conditions)

Tom — good news: Procurement has approved a temporary invoice-only admission for StrataSeed with the following conditions: 

1) Total pilot cap: $9,500 (one-time).
2) Net30 payment terms.
3) Signed SOW on company letterhead referencing the cap and pilot dates (attached signed-SOW-stub.pdf).
4) W-9 and primary billing contact (we need an email and phone).
5) We will run a 30-day checkpoint; if the pilot converts to a paid subscription we will require a PO for ongoing billing.
6) If AP cannot provide W-9 within 7 business days, Redwood reserves the right to request card-on-file to finalize onboarding.

Please send the signed SOW and W-9 to onboarding@redwood.com and copy the billing contact. Once we have those items we'll route the invoice-only admission to Ops to complete SR onboarding.

Links: HubSpot deal (HS-54932): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-54932
DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

—Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
